CPU_timing_boundary: Query telemetry CSV writes and some container copying are included in instrumented compute time. Initialization of reset copies,input parse,reference,posthoc diagnostics and raw verification are excluded. Oracle initialization is borrowed from RETAIN_FRONTIER;oracle update lookup/mutation timing is not a comparable online ACK.
power_clock_control: Unmodified;not characterized as a controlled timing campaign.
sampling: One fixed deterministic sample/order;shared-host instrumented CPU observations,not a latency confidence interval.
